verified: Affine input LayerNorm is applied after both token lookup and direct embeddings, before the first attention normalization, matching bloom.cpp.
QKV slices use query width and two KV widths, with checked head dimension and GQA divisibility; projection, residual, normalized GELU feed-forward and final affine norm follow source graph order.
Optional output matrix falls back to input embeddings exactly; bias and norm vector widths, QKV/FFN matrix shapes and required tensors are checked before model construction.
ALiBi fixes max bias to 8, uses floor(log2(heads)) for the head-power partition, source m0/m1 and odd-tail exponent ordering, and native powf-compatible f32 arithmetic.
The integer relative causal mask is negated before conversion to f32, preserving positive-zero diagonal; dot products scale before slope*mask addition and softmax operates on a 256-padded row.

Loader bounds layer count, validates context/epsilon/head fields, enforces scalar head/FFN metadata boundary and F32 active vectors, rejects unconsumed tensors, and applies the shared checked decoded-weight-byte budget before materializing weights.
Cache layer count and position lengths are checked; max context and KV width multiplication are checked. Attention buffer reservations are fallible.
limitations: Review did not execute tests or regenerate the native corpus. Independent numerical execution remains the implementation worker's evidence.

Review covers the declared contiguous single-sequence CPU graph and loader contract; it does not establish flash attention, per-layer heterogeneous metadata, general original scheduling or complete model-family portability.
Global source/model identity and fixture coverage beyond the inspected files were not re-audited.
